description: Java class for managing MIDI port connections between remote devices, including opening, closing, and connecting MIDI device ports.

classes.name: MidiPortConnector
classes.description: A utility class for connecting MIDI ports between two remote MIDI devices, handling device opening, port connection, and resource management.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes open MIDI device connections and resources, handling potential IOExceptions.

methods.name: safeClose
methods.description: Safely closes resources, catching and logging IOExceptions.

methods.name: connectToDevicePort
methods.description: Overloaded method to connect two MIDI devices' ports, either with or without a callback listener and handler.

methods.name: connectToDevicePort (private)
methods.description: Establishes connection from source device's output port to a destination input port, managing device opening and connection callback.
